backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining types and storage for sessions, context switches, achievements, breaks, reports, and focus scores with functions to record and retrieve user productivity data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three high-confidence features for detailed real-time metrics display, LiveMonitor validation section, and useFocusMonitor hook enhancements with switching history.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components and pages including Dashboard, LiveMonitor with validation metrics, break pages, achievements, reports, and burnout monitoring components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes including colors for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, borders, charts, and sidebar.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx for the Productivity & Focus Monitoring Application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component with TanStack Router setup, theme provider, protected/public routes, and burnout monitoring logic that shows warnings, grayscale overlay, and block screen based on burnout levels.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsBadg: Individual achievement badge card component displaying image, title, description, unlock status with date, and progress bar for locked achievements.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsGall: Achievements gallery displaying all badges in a grid with unlock count, export button, and share functionality that copies achievement to clipboard.
frontend/src/components/BlockScreen.tsx: Full-screen blocking interface that displays a 25-minute countdown timer with progress bar and rotating productivity tips. Timer only advances when user maintains focus with low tab switching.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutWarning.t: Bottom-right notification card that appears when burnout index reaches 30+, displaying the current burnout level and suggesting desk recovery breaks. Dismissible and reappears if burnout increases by 10+ points.
frontend/src/components/DailyRecommendat: Card component that displays a numbered list of personalized daily recommendations to improve user focus.
frontend/src/components/DistractionWarni: Non-intrusive bottom-right notification that appears when frequent tab switching is detected, showing switch count and encouraging focused work. Dismissible with smooth animations.
frontend/src/components/GreyscaleOverlay: Full-screen overlay that applies progressive grayscale filter when burnout exceeds level 2 (index > 60), with intensity increasing proportionally up to 100% at burnout index 100.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout with sticky header, navigation menu, quick action buttons, and Internet Identity authentication with profile dropdown. Includes dashboard, monitor, apps, achievements, and reports navigation.
frontend/src/components/MetricsCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a metric title, value, icon, and optional trend indicator with color-coded up/down styling.
frontend/src/components/PatternCard.tsx: Card component for displaying positive or negative behavioral patterns with title, description, trend text, and color-coded styling based on pattern type.
frontend/src/components/PeriodicReport.t: Report view with time period selector (week/month) that displays positive patterns and areas for improvement using PatternCard components. Includes export functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProductivityScor: Card displaying overall productivity score (0-100) with circular progress indicator, color-coded rating label, and contextual feedback message based on score ranges.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: A route guard component that checks Internet Identity authentication status, shows a loading spinner during initialization, and redirects unauthenticated users to the login page.
frontend/src/components/RecoveryQualityC: Displays a pie chart showing the percentage and time breakdown of restorative vs. non-restorative breaks using Recharts, with data from the break analytics hook.
frontend/src/components/ValidationMetric: Displays detailed validation metrics for app switching behavior including total switches, frequency rates, distraction score breakdown, and a table of recent switching events with timestamps and durations.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: Manages a static list of achievements with unlock status and progress tracking, providing functionality to share achievement text to clipboard.
Simulates application switching activity by randomly switching between apps every 8 seconds, persists state to localStorage, and records switches to the backend actor while calculating switching frequency metrics.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance using React Query, automatically recreating it when Internet Identity changes and invalidating dependent queries on actor updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useApplications.ts: Manages a list of applications categorized as productive or distracting, persisting to localStorage with CRUD operations for adding, updating, and removing applications.
frontend/src/hooks/useBlockingLogic.ts: Implements progressive warning system that blocks the screen after 2 warning dismissals, requiring a 25-minute productive session with low switching frequency to unblock, with timer only decrementing when user is focused.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakAnalytics.ts: Returns hardcoded break analytics data showing 45 minutes of restorative time and 15 minutes of non-restorative time with calculated percentages.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakTimer.ts: Manages a countdown timer for desk recovery or walk breaks, records break sessions to the backend actor when completed, and provides formatted time display and control functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreathingAnimation: Manages breathing exercise animation phases (inhale, hold, exhale, rest) with corresponding scale values, cycling through a 16-second pattern when active.
frontend/src/hooks/useBurnoutMonitor.ts: Calculates and tracks burnout index (0-100) based on tab switching frequency and distraction scores from useFocusMonitor, with three levels triggering warnings or grayscale overlay. Persists state to localStorage and allows dismissing warnings that reappear if burnout increases significantly.
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardData.ts: Aggregates focus scores and reports from backend queries to compute dashboard metrics including focus time, distraction time, switching frequency, productivity score, burnout trends, and personalized recommendations. Falls back to mock data when backend data is unavailable.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusMonitor.ts: Monitors browser tab visibility and window focus events to track distraction metrics (switch count, time away, distraction score) using Page Visibility API and focus/blur events. Sends aggregated data to backend every 10+ seconds and maintains a rolling window of events for calculating switches per minute/hour.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusTimer.ts: Simple timer hook that counts elapsed seconds when active and formats the duration as MM:SS.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and auth client lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching reports, focus scores, and activity data from the backend actor with automatic refetching (5-10s intervals), plus a mutation hook for recording focus scores that invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useReportData.ts: Returns mock positive and negative behavioral patterns for weekly/monthly reports with loading state simulation.
frontend/src/hooks/useWalkBreakTimer.ts: Manages a countdown timer for walk breaks with start/pause/reset controls, plays an alert sound on completion, and records break data to the backend actor when reset.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, supportive color palette for light and dark themes, including primary, secondary, accent, and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/copyConstants.ts: Centralized copy/text constants for the application including app name, dashboard messages, warning thresholds, blocking messages, and break activity descriptions with benefits.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Page component displaying user achievements and productivity milestones using the AchievementsGallery component.
frontend/src/pages/AppCategorization.tsx: Page for managing application categories (productive vs distracting) with add, edit, and delete functionality using the useApplications hook.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying focus metrics, productivity score, burnout trends, distraction warnings, and recommendations with real-time focus monitoring and tab-switching detection.
frontend/src/pages/DeskRecovery.tsx: Guided breathing exercise page with animated breathing circle, timer controls, and step-by-step instructions for desk recovery breaks.
frontend/src/pages/LiveMonitor.tsx: Real-time activity monitoring page showing current application usage, focus duration, tab switching metrics, and validation metrics with backend data integration and fallback mock data.
frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Login page component that uses Internet Identity for authentication, displays a branded login card with secure sign-in button, and redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Reports page component that renders the PeriodicReport component to display behavioral patterns and productivity habit analysis.
frontend/src/pages/WalkBreak.tsx: Walk break timer page with configurable duration (5-60 minutes), visual countdown display, progress bar, and pause/reset controls for managing walking breaks.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: TypeScript type definitions for Application (with productive/distracting categories), ContextSwitch, and FocusSession data structures.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, extended theme including chart colors, custom animations, and typography/container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a privacy-first productivity monitoring application with context switching detection, burnout tracking, progressive interventions, and break quality algorithms using React frontend and Motoko backend.
